title: Low-res density grid from particles (reuse VolumeRenderer path)
purpose: Generate a coarse 3D density grid (e.g., 96^3–128^3) from particle positions to support iso-surface shell extraction for RT self-shadowing.

steps.detail: Created 96³ R16_SFLOAT coarse density image with mip chain and views (GENERAL for compute, SAMPLED for reads). Added CoarseDensityParams struct with configurable parameters.
Implemented updateCoarseDensityGrid() method reusing existing density splat pipeline with atomic adds. Grid cleared at frame start before particle splatting.
Implemented generateCoarseMipChain() using vkCmdBlitImage with Vulkan 1.4 Synchronization2 barriers (VkImageMemoryBarrier2, vkCmdPipelineBarrier2). No transitions inside dynamic rendering.
Grid bounds configured to fit particle simulation space (-30 to +30 units). Origin, voxel size (0.625), and splat radius (1.5) logged during initialization.

acceptance: ✅ Density grid updated per frame via updateCoarseDensityGrid() call in MeshParticleRenderer::render()
✅ Grid properly initialized with non-zero density when particles present
✅ No validation errors; proper Synchronization2 barriers between compute and blit operations
✅ Correct layout transitions: GENERAL for compute writes ↔ TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL for blit ↔ SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL for reads
touchpoints: src/systems/VolumeRenderer.cpp: Added createCoarseDensityGrid(), updateCoarseDensityGrid(), generateCoarseMipChain() methods
src/systems/VolumeRenderer.h: Added CoarseDensityParams struct and coarse density resources
src/systems/MeshParticleRenderer.cpp: Added updateCoarseDensityGrid() call in render() method
mcp_queries: Used mcp__vulkan_db__search_vulkan_api for VkImageMemoryBarrier2 structure details
Used mcp__vulkan_db__get_vulkan_entity for vkCmdPipelineBarrier2 synchronization requirements

completion_status: COMPLETED - Foundation ready for Job 1013 (iso-surface shell extraction)
notes: Coarse resolution optimized for RT shell extraction performance. Grid provides foundation for marching cubes algorithm in Job 1013. All validation requirements met with zero errors.
